title: 27th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/27/2/2026).

Kendhoo MP Maaruf Zakir asks Youth, Sports and Fitness Minister Abdulla Rafiu in writing when stalled work on the fitness and recreation centre in B. Kudarikilu, announced by the President in August 2025, will restart and finish.

Kendhoo MP Maaruf Zakir asks Youth, Sports and Fitness Minister Abdulla Rafiu in writing why work on the fitness centre and outdoor gym in B. Dhonfanu, handed over in 2025, has not started and when it will.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Information Commissioner (Right to Information Act, Law No. 1/2014, Article 44) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Debate on a petition, referred by the Petitions Committee, calling for the amendments submitted to the Decentralization Act to be withdrawn.
Debate on a petition, referred by the Petitions Committee, calling for the amendments submitted to the Decentralization Act to be passed as they stand.
Committee of the Whole House report on the bill to amend the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011).
Committee of the Whole House report on the bill to amend the Income Tax Act (Law No. 25/2019).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: Parliament debated two opposing public petitions on the Decentralization Act changes, received committee reports on the GST and income tax amendment bills, and took written questions on stalled sports facilities.
